source: WorldClim 2.1 (Fick & Hijmans 2017), monthly 1970-2000 climatologies, 10 arc-min: tmin, tmax, vapr. Place polygons: Natural Earth, resolved identically to shapes.json; the 207 places that exist only in shapes-hd.json are measured over shapes-hd.json's own polygons.
method: Per place, per month, percentiles across the place's 10-arcmin land pixels. tnLo=p05 of monthly-mean daily minimum (°C), tnMed/txMed=medians, txHi=p95 of monthly-mean daily maximum. RH derived from vapour pressure via FAO-56 es(T): rhHi=p95 of RH at tmin (dawn), rhLo=p05 of RH at tmax (afternoon), rhLo50/rhHi50=medians of the same series (the TYPICAL daily swing — what the card displays; p05 is a triple extreme: driest pixels x driest hour x driest month), %. annTnMin/annTxMax are absolute pixel extremes across the year. Variants: "all"=every land pixel; "ff"=frost-free pixels (coldest-month mean tmin >= 0°C); "warm"=coldest-month mean tmin >= 10°C (50°F); "warmMoist"=warm AND World-Terrestrial-Ecosystems Moist domain (clips hot/dry extremes: Thar-class pixels out). ffShare/warmShare/wmShare=fractions. Client rule: find the species' warm strongholds (tagged places with warmShare >= 0.5); if any exist and the majority of strongholds have a Moist top zone (of their warm variant), read every place through warmMoist (fall back warm, ff, all where absent); if strongholds exist but are majority-dry, use warm (fall back ff, all); otherwise ff when ffShare >= 0.10, else all. zones=[name,share] top WTE temperature x moisture domains over the variant's pixels (via the site's own resampled shapefile). method:"centroid" means the polygon covered no 10-arcmin land pixel and the nearest valid pixel to the place centroid was used. prMed=median monthly precipitation (mm) over the pixels of each variant, from WorldClim 2.1 10-arcmin prec; it is the ONLY field that carries a dry season, because derived dew point tracks the daily minimum temperature too closely to separate dry air from cool air. Months are calendar Jan-Dec; these are 30-year monthly MEANS of daily extremes, not record temperatures. 1.9.0: places absent from places.json (the shapes-hd-only 207) are measured over the shapes-hd.json polygon (the audit sidecar marks them layer "shapes-hd"); lat/lon for those is the polygon vertex centroid, longitude averaged circularly. 1.10.0: koppen=[code, share] per variant — the distribution of full Koppen-Geiger classes (Peel et al. 2007: B checked first with the 10x(2xMAT[+14|+28]) mm threshold, C/D boundary 0 degC, hemisphere from the pixel row, Tmean=(tmin+tmax)/2) across the variant's own pixels; shares of classified pixels (a pixel with any no-data precipitation month is unclassified). Coarsen client-side; never re-split. 1.12.0: elev={slab:250, bands:{<floor m>: {n, k, tn, tx}}} over the all-variant pixels — n pixels in the 250 m slab, k its Koppen mix (shares >= 0.02), tn/tx the slab's coldest-month median tmin and hottest-month median tmax (degC), elevation from WorldClim 2.1 10-arcmin elev on the same grid. Consumers intersect a species' stated altitude band with these slabs; a single stated altitude widens by one slab each way. 1.13.0: Peel's Cs and Cw criteria overlap and his ordering gives every tie to Cs, which labelled summer-rain tropics "mediterranean" (Malawi 33% Cs, Njombe 91%, Jalisco 67%) because the fixed six-month summer block sits ~1 month off the real rainfall calendar in both hemispheres; where BOTH criteria pass the stronger contrast now wins (Pswet/Pwdry vs Pwwet/Psdry). 102 places change, all between 0.5 and 31 degrees; no genuine winter-rain region is affected. The equatorial bimodal belt (two rainy seasons, no meaningful summer) remains undescribable by a six-month split. 1.14.0: +10 Ghana regions (WGSRPD L4, ghana-l4-spec 8.20.26 v1) - Natural Earth carries the pre-2018 ten; Central/Eastern/Northern/Western are keyed -GH because those bare names belong to 7-9 admin_1 units worldwide. 1.15.0: the 12 parenthetical keys (Amazonas (Venezuela), Bolivar (Ecuador), ...) are renamed to the same -XX suffix convention (Amazonas-VE, Bolivar-EC); geometry and all measurements are unchanged, only the key moved. Cocos (Keeling) Is. is NOT renamed - its brackets are part of the real name of the territory. 1.16.0: +55 West African level-4 units - Ivory Coast 19 pre-2011 regions and Liberia 15 counties 1:1 with Natural Earth; Burkina Faso 13 regions and Guinea 8 regions built as UNIONS of the NE provinces/prefectures, which is the level sources cite and which also stops Guineas MALI prefecture from ever being keyed against the country of the same name. 1.17.0: +32 more West African level-4 units (Togo 5, Sierra Leone 4, Mali 9, Senegal 14), all 1:1 with Natural Earth. ALL FOUR Sierra Leone provinces are suffix-qualified because they are bare directions shared with 5-9 admin_1 units worldwide; Mali and Senegal collide with nothing and stay bare. 1.18.0: +90 Central African level-4 units (WGSRPD West-Central Tropical Africa: Cameroon 10, Gabon 9, Congo 12, DR Congo 11, Central African Republic 17, Equatorial Guinea 7, Sao Tome and Principe 2, Burundi 17, Rwanda 5), all 1:1 with Natural Earth. Bioko, Annobon, Sao Tome and Principe parent to the Gulf of Guinea Islands rather than to their country, because that is the WGSRPD unit that contains them. the Benin Littoral key was renamed Littoral-BJ against the Cameroon one. 1.19.0: +176 East African level-4 units (Kenya 8, Uganda 110, Chad 22, Eritrea 6, Somalia 13, Sudan 17), all 1:1 with Natural Earth; Tanzania and Ethiopia were already done. Uganda MBARARA is skipped because Natural Earth carries TWO features of that name covering different ground and a name resolves to one feature, so keying it would silently ship half the district. 1.20.0: BORNEO re-sourced onto ONE geometry layer (geoBoundaries) from the island down, because Natural Earth publishes no admin-2 anywhere and mixing sources was measured to disagree along the Sarawak-Kalimantan frontier by a median 0.32 km with 36.6 percent of vertices past the simplify tolerance. Adds NORTH KALIMANTAN (created 2012, absent from NE) and 17 DIVISIONS - Sarawak 12, Sabah 5 - built as unions of the 40 and 27 districts, which are never keyed. 1.21.0: removed two DUPLICATE sidecar shapes - Cayman Is. and Solomon Is. - which duplicated the curated places.json keys Cayman Islands and Solomon Islands. Cayman Is. shipped GRAND CAYMAN ALONE against the curated 3-subpath shape, i.e. exactly the loss the DETAIL entry exists to prevent. Both WGSRPD spellings now resolve as card aliases instead.
